facts.text: Youngsville sits in the Town of Callicoon along New York State Route 52, about seven miles west of Liberty.
The town’s future museum will occupy the historic Sugar Mill Refinery office at 307 Iberia Street, a landmark slated to open in 2026.
The Youngsville Historical Preservation Society, founded in 2019, runs the museum as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to safeguarding artifacts and oral histories.
Volunteer curators and local schools partner with the museum to provide educational programs that bring Youngsville’s past to life for students and residents.
Youngsville’s history reflects a rapid growth from a small settlement to a thriving community, a narrative highlighted on the city’s official website.
The museum’s mission is to preserve photographs, artifacts, and memories before they’re lost, while inspiring future generations through exhibits and community events.
